title: Soul Blues
style: Soul-blues, 12-takt smooth, electric guitar, hammondorgel, drums, groovy bass, emotionell, blues inspirered soulful male ande female song
lyrics:
[Intro – instrumental groove](Drums, bass, tambourine — slow build with brass and slide guitar.)
Halloween
All Saints’ night
Two worlds blend
beneath the light.
Trick or treat
and candle flame
Different paths
yet both the same.

[Verse 1 – Male voice (raspy, relaxed)]
We think of those
who came before
We knock
on every neighbor’s door
Whispers of the past still call —
Life and death can dance through all.

[Chorus – Both voices (call & response, playful groove)]
Candies and graves
laughter and tears
Holding the lost
through all these years.
Remember the dead
but live it well
Fill your days
with tales to tell.
Candies and graves
sweet and true
That’s what the dead
would want us to do.

[Verse 2 – Female voice (husky, sensual tone)]
Light a flame
let silence fall
Hear the nightbirds’
mournful call.
It’s just a show
it’s just a game
But love and loss
still burn the same.

[Bridge – Call & Response / Dance break]
(male)
Maybe both
are wrong and right
Joy and sorrow
share the night.

(female)
Freedom
in the choice we make
To live
to laugh
for memory’s sake.

[Chorus – Both voices (raspy, joyful energy)]
Candies and graves
laughter and tears
Holding the lost
through all these years.
Remember the dead
but live it well
Fill your days
with tales to tell.
Candies and graves
sweet and true
That’s what the dead
would want us to do.

[Instrumental break – brass & guitar solo](Deep swamp groove — tambourine and handclaps build up the rhythm.)

[Bridge – Call & Response / Dance break]
(male)
Death’s the best invention yet
A truth we learn
we can’t forget.

(female)
So while you can
just play your part
Keep the fire
inside your heart.

[Final Chorus – Both voices (raspy, celebratory, improvised ad-libs)]
Candies and graves
laughter and tears
Dancing with ghosts
through all our years.
Remember the dead —
then take your chance
Life’s a fleeting
shining dance.
Candies and graves
both hand in hand
That’s how the living understand.
